description: This is a Bash shell script for managing PR review lifecycle dates across project components. It includes functions for starting, stopping, and clearing review cycles, handling date calculations, and generating reports. It interacts with YAML metadata files to set or clear lifecycle dates.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds all components with metadata.yaml files excluding documentation and scripts directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help message with usage instructions and available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the path to a component's metadata.yaml file, validating its existence.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a future date by adding a number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears review lifecycle dates in a metadata.yaml file by setting them to null (~).

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG status report by executing an external script.
